The [[Arthropleura]] is a large, [[extinct]] millipede from the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carboniferous Carboniferous] period, found in [[savage]] [[temperate]] freshwater [[swamp|swamps]] and [[marsh|marshes]], as well as savage temperate [[Broadleaf forest|broadleaf]] and [[coniferous forest|coniferous forests]].  As with all real-world extinct creatures, their spawning depends on settings chosen during world creation.

Arthropleuras, despite their creature description calling them small, can grow to be very large, with their maximum size being equivalent to that of a [[cheetah]] or a [[gorlak]]. Despite their size, arthropleuras are benign and generally pose no threat to dwarves. Like most arthropods, arthropleuras are covered in [[chitin]] and are filled with [[ichor]].

Arthropleuras have a decent [[pet]] value of 100. Although they are tagged as not butcherable, this tag has no effect on slaughtering, (possibly a bug or oversight) so they can still be used as a source of food if tamed. They cannot be trained for war or hunting.

Some dwarves [[like]] arthropleura for their ''majesty''
